topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the subject of complement and sets pedagogical expectations for the session.

topics.label: Core principles and molecular foundations of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational architecture, naming conventions, and central role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three upstream pathways that trigger complement activation and drive surface deposition of C3b.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the downstream effector processes through which activated complement eradicates pathogens and promotes inflammation.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory factors and mechanisms that prevent complement activation on healthy host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the distinct clinical presentations and disease patterns associated with deficiencies in specific complement proteins.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the strategies employed by pathogens to resist and evade complement-mediated immune clearance.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation on complement and previews the next lecture on the adaptive immune system.
